prompt: Concurrency bug in Config Service `AccessKeyServiceWithCache`. `getSecrets(appId, filter)` streams over the live list from the synchronized multimap `accessKeyCache` without holding its lock, so a concurrent cache refresh can throw ConcurrentModificationException. In addition, when an access key is updated the refresh puts the new key and removes the old one as two separate operations, so a reader can briefly see both versions of the same key (or neither). Make readers work on a snapshot copied under the multimap's lock, and make the old→new replacement a single mutation under the same lock.

oracle_plan.instruction: getSecrets: copy the list under synchronized(accessKeyCache) and filter the copy. Refresh: inside synchronized(accessKeyCache) remove the outdated key (if replaced) and put the new one.
